weakness: Editable visual artifacts lacked machine-readable implementation constraints, allowing design-to-code drift.
hypothesis: Pairing every SVG with design tokens and explicit pass/fail criteria will reduce unresolved implementation questions by at least 50 percent across the next three art-to-build handoffs.
experiment: Require SVG plus token JSON plus acceptance criteria.
risks: Token files may duplicate values already represented in CSS
Premature token rigidity may constrain exploration
rollback: Retain the SVG and remove the token coupling requirement if implementation questions do not decline after three handoffs.
